findings.issue_text: UpdateCompatibilityCheck.java and UpdateCompatibilityMetadata.java call picocli.exit(4), which invokes System.exit directly and bypasses Picocli execution-result handling, causing incorrect behavior when hard exits are suppressed in test or embedded launch modes; use a returnable exit-code mechanism such as Callable<Integer>
